component.name: OpenRAGE
component.summary: Explore and mod GTA V, GTA IV and Red Dead Redemption 2

description.p: OpenRAGE is an open-source successor to OpenIV. It browses and searches every archive of the game, previews textures, models, sounds and animations, reads metadata as XML, edits game text and installs .oiv packages, compatible with OpenIV's mods folder and with undo.
OpenRAGE contains no game files and no encryption keys: keys are taken from your own copy of the game. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
